items.title: Can AT&T (T) Turn Satellite Handoffs Into A Real Wireless Edge?
items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T) reports a first successful handoff between ground cellular and direct to device satellite service with AST SpaceMobile. The test involved support from network equipment vendors Ericsson and Nokia to coordinate terrestrial and satellite connectivity on standard smartphones. The breakthrough targets coverage gaps in remote and rural areas where traditional cell towers are limited or absent.
